publication.label: The Nurse · 1v4 Quartet Rankings
publication.description: Fictional sample data for reviewing Dead by Daylight 1v4 quartet leaderboards. All included matches use The Nurse.

competition.label: Dead by Daylight · 1v4 Quartet
competition.description: One killer player faces a survivor party that queues together as a group of four players. Each survivor party competes as one ranked unit. Matches can end in a killer win, a survivor win, or a draw.

category.label: Killer
category.description: Killer character used by the killer side in every included match.

value.label: The Nurse
value.description: The killer side played The Nurse.

methodology_description: Ranking scores describe current-season competitive performance among units eligible when this snapshot is generated. Entry ratings determine eligibility and do not directly contribute to ranking scores. Killers and survivor parties have separate boards; each survivor party counts as one ranked unit and one opponent. In this illustrative publication, all encounters between the same killer player and survivor party share a total calculation weight capped at one match-equivalent, divided equally among their encounters. Every encounter remains in match totals and evidence. Scores are hand-authored for this fictional preview, not calculated by a ranking model.

boards.label: Killer rankings
boards.description: Eligible individual players competing as The Nurse against survivor parties this season.

score_definition.label: Ranking score
score_definition.description: Illustrative integer points: higher scores rank ahead within this board, and equal scores share a rank. Points are not a win percentage or an entry rating. Compare scores only within this board and snapshot; no comparison with the survivor board, other killers, seasons, or refreshes is supported.

rating.label: The Nurse killer entry rating
rating.description: Individual killer entry rating for playing The Nurse in 1v4 quartet. This fictional preview uses a 0–3000 point scale where higher values indicate stronger performance. Individual entry ratings are not published.

eligibility.description: At generation time, killer players need a Nurse killer entry rating of at least 1200 points and at least three current-season matches against survivor parties in the calculation-time eligible pool. Repeat encounters count toward participation. Eligibility is reevaluated on every refresh, even without new matches. These thresholds are illustrative.

boards.label: Survivor party rankings
boards.description: Eligible parties that queue as four survivors and compete together against The Nurse this season. Each row ranks a whole party.

score_definition.label: Ranking score
score_definition.description: Illustrative integer points: higher scores rank ahead within this board, and equal scores share a rank. Points are not a win percentage or an entry rating. Compare scores only within this board and snapshot; no comparison with the killer board, other killers, seasons, or refreshes is supported.

rating.label: The Nurse survivor party entry rating
rating.description: Group entry rating for a survivor party facing The Nurse in 1v4 quartet. This fictional preview uses a 0–3000 point scale where higher values indicate stronger performance. Individual party entry ratings are not published.

eligibility.description: At generation time, survivor parties need a Nurse survivor party entry rating of at least 1200 points and at least three current-season matches against killer players in the calculation-time eligible pool. Repeat encounters count toward participation. Eligibility is reevaluated on every refresh, even without new matches. These thresholds are illustrative.

public_facts_schema.description: Winning side or draw, generators remaining, hooks, and kills for a 1v4 quartet match. The killer character comes from publication scope. Published group members describe the generation-time roster, not a historical match lineup.
